title.en: The Gulf Land Books and the Old Villages

desc.zh: 旧村按祖界，移民按新契。设混合法庭、推统一地契或保住旧界，三条路都要真付一次开庭费，再以真在岗官署与真实土地法承接。六个月观察决定成败，受阻满十二个月提示、三十六个月给退出。
desc.en: Old villages by ancestral line, migrants by new deed. A mixed court, unified titles or protected old boundaries: each costs a real sitting fee and needs a staffed office plus a real land law. A six-month watch decides the result, with a notice at twelve months and an exit at thirty-six.

title.en: The Last Page of the Survey

desc.zh: 地权已经写进册子，剩下的是税、迁入与结算。按真实税源与官署承载推进，把结果写死在国家账本上，然后让出名额。
desc.en: The titles are in the book; what remains is tax, migration and settlement. Proceed on a genuine tax base and staffed office, write the result into the country ledger, then free the slot.

desc.zh: 旧村按祖界耕作，移民按新契开垦，两套凭据在同一个官署里互相否定。地方议员要一个说法，华墨社群愿意出钱，朱氏仪礼房只问谁的名册算数。三条路都要真金白银。
desc.en: Old villages farm by ancestral boundary; migrants clear land on new deeds, and the two paper trails cancel each other inside one office. The council wants a ruling, the community will pay, and the Zhu ritual house asks only whose register counts.

title.en: The Mexico City Bill and the Local Budget

desc.zh: 开账：固定分担、共同项目或旧额拖欠。先真读属邦关系与宗主态度，再把税源、防务与官署底账对上。本段只开账，不谈条款。
desc.en: Opening the account: a fixed share, a joint project, or arrears on the old figure. First read the real subject relation and the overlord's temper, then reconcile the tax base, garrison and office books. This stage opens the account only; terms come later.

desc.zh: 谈判：据实压价还是接受宗主底价，取决于真实两国关系与财政能力。共同项目需真建筑与真出资，拖欠则什么都写不下来。
desc.en: Negotiation: press for the real figure or accept the overlord's floor, depending on real relations and fiscal capacity. A joint project needs real buildings and real money; arrears writes nothing down at all.

desc.zh: 结算：把当年的汇单、工料账与营房名册并成一卷。尾数认下来还是记成争议，直接改动真实外交关系。归档后让出名额。
desc.en: Settlement: fold the year's remittances, works accounts and garrison muster into one volume. Owning or disputing the residue moves real diplomatic relations. Filing frees the slot.
